title: TaskEnvelope
description: The only object a runner may execute from. It binds a command, a resource scope, an allowlisted adapter, an approval (when required), and a lease fencing sequence. Anything not named here is out of scope by construction.

resource_scope.description: Dotted logical scope, e.g. `project.synthetic-alpha.workbook`. Never a filesystem path.

adapter.description: Must appear in the server-side adapter allowlist. Arbitrary shell or SQL is not representable.

parameters.description: Adapter-specific, schema-validated. Hashed into `content_sha256`; changing any parameter after approval invalidates the approval binding.

execution_mode.description: SIMULATED results MUST be labeled SIMULATED in UI, API, audit, and receipt.

approval_token_id.description: Required and non-null when risk_class is APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

fencing_sequence.description: Monotonic per resource scope. A write carrying a sequence lower than the current one MUST fail closed.

input_hashes.description: logical input id -> sha256. Re-verified immediately before execution; mismatch aborts.
